items.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued October 9 at 2:12AM PDT until October 13 at 2:00PM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Beach Hazards Statement, surf of 3 to 5 feet with
sets to 6 feet and dangerous rip currents expected. For the
Coastal Flood Advisory, minor coastal flooding expected during
high tides.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas and Orange County
Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, until 2 PM PDT Tuesday.
For the Beach Hazards Statement, through Friday evening.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of beach parking lots, boardwalks, and
roads with only isolated road closures expected. Minor coastal
erosion is also expected. Additionally, elevated surf will
lead to strong rip currents and dangerous swimming conditions.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...High tides are expected to peak between
6.5 and 7.0 feet during the mornings and evenings. Additional
south swells may produce another round of elevated to high
surf Sunday through Tuesday, highest on Sunday.
items.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.

Remain out of the water to avoid hazardous swimming conditions.
